verdict.rationale: Square publishes official SDKs: a first-party TypeScript library in the square GitHub org with usage examples such as client.payments.create, and a documented Mobile Payments SDK for iOS and Android. Its API spec README points developers to pre-built clients in their language of choice. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the full set of supported SDK languages beyond TypeScript and mobile, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Square TypeScript library provides convenient access to the Square APIs from TypeScript.
You probably want to just use one of the clients that are pre-built in a language of your choice
